milestones.text: CARE's first event, a Breast Cancer Awareness Seminar at the Dr Zaki Hasan Auditorium, Jinnah Medical & Dental College.
The first medical camp, a free ENT camp at Sohail Trust Hospital with ENT specialists and student volunteers.
A two-day Free Eye Camp at Sohail Trust Hospital. 180 patients were served and 20 people were identified for free cataract surgery.
The Drug Bank opened, and the first blood drive of a six-month series with Saylani Welfare took place.
A Basic Life Support workshop for MBBS students, run with FRIP.
A flood relief appeal with GSIG, and a free medical camp at Al-Furqan Welfare covering general medicine, dental care, physiotherapy, paediatrics and gynaecology.
Medical camps at Anmol Zindagi Old Age Home and Mubarak Village, a Heat Relief Camp, a blood drive with Indus Hospital and a First Responders Course with REVIVE.
